qualityRating.summary: The April 2024 update praises extensive Turkish food and showers, despite crowding and strict sleep-suite eligibility. Historical evidence predating later layout changes; do not expect the old open daybeds.

sources.title: Live and Let’s Fly · Turkish Business (April 2024 update)

lounges.note: Star Alliance Gold in Economy uses Miles&Smiles instead. Sleep suites have separate eligibility: a paid Turkish Business ticket or Elite Plus, a Turkish flight of at least eight hours, a four-to-nine-hour connection, and both international flights on Turkish on the same ticket. Ordinary lounge access does not guarantee a suite.

recommendation.summary: A strong food and shower option for eligible premium-cabin travellers, including overnight connections.

qualityRating.summary: The April 2024 update describes substantial food choice, showers and plenty of seating, with crowding at busy times. A strong status lounge; its layout assessment predates subsequent expansion work.

recommendation.summary: The international status lounge for Star Alliance Gold travellers, with a buffet and showers around the clock.
